text: Austria here. I propose peace: no one attacks into home centers in 1901. Italy and Austria can coordinate against Turkey or Russia if needed. Russia, I am open to not contesting Galicia and Rumania if you leave Vienna and Trieste alone. Let's all aim for a stable opening and keep our centers.

England here. I propose peace: no one attacks anyone in 1901, and we focus on neutral centers. England will take NWY/SWE/DEN and HOL/BEL from the sea side and I will not contest Continental powers' home centers. Open to a unanimous draw later if the board stays balanced.
France here. I propose peace on all our borders: no moves into ENG, BUR, or PIC. I will aim at Iberia first. Happy to coordinate against whoever turns aggressive.

Germany here. I propose a peaceful opening: no one attacks anyone in 1901 and we focus on neutral centers (Holland, Belgium, Denmark, Sweden, Norway). Russia, I am open to a non-aggression pact in the north; let's both avoid Prussia/Warsaw conflict this year. Austria and Italy: I'm happy to stay out of the south and west if you do the same.

Italy here. I want peace and a fair split. Italy will hold its home centers and avoid early wars with anyone who does the same. Austria, I suggest we agree no moves into each other's home centers in 1901. Open to coordinating against whoever grabs too fast.

Russia here. I propose peace: no one attacks anyone's home centers in 1901. Russia will stay defensive in the north and east and will not attack Germany or Austria. Open to a non-aggression pact with Turkey in the south; Sweden, Norway and Finland are open for anyone who gets there first, so let's avoid stepping on each other. Happy to hear other proposals.

Turkey proposes peace to all. Let's avoid early wars and keep the Black Sea and Balkans for those who need them. Turkey will take BUL and GRE neutral centers and leave the rest alone. Russia: I'm open to a non-aggression pact in the south; tell me your plans.

Austria: agreed on peace in 1901. Austria will take SER and RUM (neutral) and keep Vienna, Budapest, Trieste safe. Russia: I will not move into Galicia or Ukraine while you stay out of Rumania; Turkey, Serbia/Bulgaria are open to whoever reaches them first. Italy: no moves into each other's homes; I will stay out of Venice and Apulia if you stay out of Trieste and Tyrolia.

England agrees with the peace proposals. Our fleets go to the North Sea and Norway; we will not attack any home center in 1901. Proposal: England and France keep the Channel and Brest/Paris/Picardy/Belgium area stable; England takes Norway and Denmark-area neutrals, Germany takes Holland/Belgium-free area as it prefers. Let's keep it simple and peaceful this year.

France: agreed on peace. I'll take Iberia (SPA/POR) and keep out of BUR, PIC, ENG, PIE. England, please keep out of the Channel and Belgium is yours to share with Germany only if you two sort it out. Let's keep the west quiet.

Germany: agreed on peace for 1901. I will grab neutral centers in the north (Denmark, Holland, Belgium) and not enter any power's home centers. Anyone who moves into Germany's home (BER, KIE, MUN) will face a united response. I'm open to a multi-way draw later if the board stays balanced; I suggest we all vote draw only once a clear balance exists.

Italy agrees with the general peace. I will take the neutral centers in the south: TUN is my target via the Ionian/Western Med, and I will not enter any power's home centers in 1901. Austria, Turkey: I'm open to a Balkan arrangement where Greece and Serbia are contested only by those who move first. Anyone planning to attack Italy, tell me now.

Russia agrees with the general peace. Proposal: Russia takes SWE/FIN/NWY region with STP fleet; Turkey takes BUL/GRE/RUM neutral centers; Austria takes SER; nobody moves into home centers in 1901. Russia will not attack Germany, Austria or Turkey this year. If anyone moves against Russia's home centers (MOS, WAR, SEV, STP), we will respond.

Turkey to Russia: I'm happy with a southern non-aggression pact. Turkey will not move into Sevastopol, Rumania or Armenia-Moscow lines this year. In return, please keep your fleets out of the Black Sea and leave Bulgaria and Greece to me. Let me know if you agree.

Austria: agreed. Plan for 1901: Austria takes SER (via Budapest/Vienna) and keeps Trieste, Vienna, Budapest safe. Russia, Rumania is contested only if you move in; I will not touch Galicia or Ukraine. Turkey, I will not move into Bulgaria or Greece this year. Let's keep the peace and revisit balance in 1902.

England: agreed on peace for 1901. My fleets go to the North Sea/Norway/Denmark area for neutral centers only (NWY, DEN, SWE, HOL/BEL if unclaimed). I will not enter any power's home centers and will not touch the Channel or France's units. Happy to revisit a balanced multi-way draw once centers stabilize.

Germany: confirming peace for 1901. My plan: fleet KIE to DEN (neutral) and army/fleet moves into HOL and BEL over the next turns. I will not enter any power's home supply center this year. Russia: I am happy with your NWY/SWE plan as long as Germany keeps DEN. England: please keep your fleets out of HEL and the Baltic. Let's report any violations quickly.

Italy confirms: no moves into any home center in 1901. My fleet and armies will take TUN and Tunisian/southern neutrals only. Austria: I will keep out of Trieste, Tyrolia and Venice-adjacent Austrian homes as long as you do the same. Thanks all; let's keep the south quiet and balanced.

Russia to Turkey: agreed on a southern non-aggression pact for 1901. I will not move into Bulgaria, Greece or Constantinople, and I will keep my fleets out of the Aegean. Please keep your units out of Sevastopol, Armenia and Rumania this year, and let's review in the Fall.

Turkey: agreed on peace for 1901. Turkey will take BUL and GRE (or RUM if Russia does not contest it) and will not enter any home center. Whoever moves against Turkey's home centers (ANK, CON, SMY) will face a united response. Open to a balanced multi-way draw later once centers are settled.
Austria: confirming peace for 1901. Austria moves to SER and keeps BUD, VIE, TRI defended. Austria will not enter any home center. Happy to revisit balance in 1902.

England: confirmed peace for 1901. I will move fleets into the North Sea toward Norway and Denmark only, no entry into any home center, and no Baltic or Channel moves. Will report any violations quickly. Open to a balanced draw once centers settle.
Italy: confirmed peace for 1901. My moves are F NAP to TYS toward Tunis and southern neutrals only; no home-center entries. Thanks all for keeping it calm.

Russia: confirming peace for 1901. My plan is STP fleet to Finland/Sweden-area neutrals and Moscow/Warsaw holds. I will not enter any power's home center this year. Austria: Rumania and Serbia are yours to contest, but I will defend Sevastopol and Ukraine if attacked. Let's report violations quickly.
Turkey to Russia: agreed. Turkey will move CON to BUL and keep its fleets out of Sevastopol, Armenia and Rumania this year. Please keep your fleets out of the Black Sea and Aegean.

England: final round. Confirming peace for 1901. My fleets move only toward Norway and the North Sea neutrals (NWY, DEN, SWE area). No home-center entries from England. Will report any violation immediately.
Italy: confirmed peace for 1901. I move F NAP to Tyrhennian toward Tunis and hold Rome and Venice. No home-center entries from me. Let's keep reporting any violations.

Russia: confirmed, peace for 1901. I will not enter any power's home center this year. Turkey: thanks for the Black Sea/Aegean pledge; Russia stays out of BUL, GRE and CON. Let's report any violations and revisit balance in Fall.

Austria: SER is now ours by Fall occupation and I will hold it. I have no plans to attack Russia or Turkey and will not enter Rumania or Bulgaria this Fall. Russia, Turkey: please keep your units out of Serbia, Budapest, Vienna and Trieste, and I will do the same. Let's keep the peace through 1901.

England: Fall 1901. Our goal is neutral centers: NWY and DEN/HOL/BEL. Austria, Turkey, Italy, Russia: I see Russia's fleet in BOT and Germany in DEN. I propose the north stays quiet: Germany takes HOL/BEL, England takes NWY (contest with Russia only if they move there). Please state your Fall orders publicly.
France: my A BUR is purely defensive. I take SPA and POR this fall. Germany, are you taking HOL/BEL? Let's not collide; I will not enter BEL if you stay out of BUR/PIC.

Italy: Fall 1901. I plan to take neutral Tunis with fleet TYS. Italy will not enter any power's home center. Austria: please keep Trieste, Venice and Tyrolia as agreed. Anyone whose units enter Italian homes will face a united response. Open to discussing Fall moves.

Russia: Fall 1901. Turkey moved A CON to BUL, so the south pact is in question; Turkey, please confirm you will keep out of SEV, ARM, RUM. Russia is taking neutral Sweden and Norway/Finland areas and will not attack any home center. Austria: SER is yours; Rumania is still open. Let's keep reporting moves and aim for a fair balance.

Turkey: Fall 1901. Our A CON-BUL succeeded and BUL is ours. I plan to take GRE this Fall with the BUL army and keep ANK, CON, SMY home. Russia: please keep your fleets out of the Black Sea and Aegean as agreed. Austria: I am not attacking SER this year. Let's keep reporting any violations.

Austria: Fall 1901. I hold SER, BUD, VIE, TRI and will not move into Rumania, Bulgaria or Greece this Fall. Turkey: noted BUL is yours. Russia: Austria will not attack Galicia or Ukraine. Let's keep reporting moves and aim for a balanced board.

England: Fall 1901 round 2. Our fleets are in the North Sea (NTH, NWG) and A YOR. I plan to move toward Norway (NWY) and Denmark/Holland via convoy, with no attacks on home centers. Russia: if your fleet moves into NWY I will not contest it this Fall; please confirm you are not moving into EDI/LON/LVP. Germany: I will not move into HEL/DEN unless you vacate. Happy to discuss a balanced northern split.

Germany: Fall 1901. I am taking neutral Holland and Belgium this Fall with RUH and the NTH/DEN fleet; I will not enter BUR, PIC or any home center. France: agreed, I stay out of BUR/PIC. England: agreed on HOL/BEL for Germany and NWY for England. Russia: DEN is mine, I will not move into SWE or BAL-Russian areas beyond it. Let's report any violations quickly.

Italy: Fall 1901 status. F TYS heads to Tunis (neutral). A ROM and A VEN stay home. Italy has not entered any power's home center and will not. Turkey: GRE and BUL are fine by Italy. Austria: keep Trieste/Venice boundary as agreed. Let's keep reporting moves.

Russia: Fall 1901. Russia holds MOS, WAR, SEV, STP and will take neutral Sweden with F BOT. Turkey: our southern pact stands; Russia keeps out of BUL/GRE/CON and the Black Sea, and I expect Turkey to stay out of SEV, ARM and RUM. Austria: thanks for keeping SER quiet toward us. Let's keep reporting moves.

Turkey to Russia: I confirm I will keep A BUL, F ANK and A SMY out of SEV, ARM and RUM this Fall. Turkey's BUL move was to take a neutral center. Please confirm your F SEV and F BOT will stay out of the Black Sea and Aegean, and that you will not enter BUL, GRE or CON.

England: Fall 1901 round 3. Confirming: I will move F NTH/NWG and A YOR toward NWY only, no attacks on any home center. Russia: if you take SWE with BOT, I will not contest it. Germany: agreed on HOL/BEL for you; I will not enter DEN or HOL. Let's report all Fall orders publicly.

Italy: Fall 1901 round 3. F TYS to Tunis (neutral) confirmed; A ROM and A VEN hold at home. Italy has no hostile intent toward any power and will not enter any home center. Let's keep reporting moves.

Russia to Turkey: confirmed. F SEV stays out of the Black Sea and Aegean this Fall, and Russia will not enter BUL, GRE or CON. Please keep A BUL, F ANK and A SMY out of SEV, ARM and RUM. Let's keep the south quiet.

Turkey: Fall 1901 round 3. Turkey holds ANK, CON, SMY and BUL. I will move A BUL to GRE this Fall as a neutral center and keep out of all home centers and SEV/ARM/RUM. Russia: confirmed, I expect no fleets in the Black Sea or Aegean. Open to a balanced Fall-1902 discussion.

England: Fall 1901 round 4. Confirming no attacks on any home center. My moves are toward Norway only (NWY neutral). Russia: if you take SWE, England will not contest. Germany: HOL/BEL are yours; England stays out of DEN and HOL. Will report all orders publicly.
Italy: Fall 1901 round 4. F TYS to Tunis (neutral) and A ROM, A VEN holding home. No home-center entries from Italy. Thanks for reporting moves; let's keep it that way.

Russia: Fall 1901 round 4. Confirming: F BOT moves to Sweden (neutral), Russia holds SEV, MOS and WAR and enters no home center or BUL/GRE/CON. England: no contest on SWE from us needed, so Russia will not move toward NWY. Let's keep reporting Fall orders publicly.

England: Fall 1901 round 5. Final confirmation: my orders are F NWG-NWY, F NTH holds or moves to NWY support, A YOR to hold. No attacks on any home center. Russia: NWY is contested only if you move there; I will not attack SWE. Germany: HOL/BEL are yours; England stays out of DEN and HOL.

England: Winter 1901. We now hold 4 centers (EDI, LON, LVP, NWY). I will build a fleet at LVP or EDI. France has grown to 6 centers after taking Spain, Portugal and Belgium; that is a concern for everyone's balance. Let's discuss a coalition to check France in 1902 before it runs away with the board.

Italy: Winter 1901. We now hold NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN. I will build in NAP. France has grown to 6 centers, which is a concern for everyone's balance. Let's discuss a stable 1902 plan that keeps every power alive and limits any single power's growth.

Russia: Winter 1901. We hold 5 centers (MOS, SEV, STP, SWE, WAR) and will build. France has grown to 6 and is the biggest threat to balance; I propose everyone watch France's expansion. Turkey, Austria: let's keep the south and Rumania open for whoever is fair, and avoid early wars.

Turkey: Winter 1901. We now hold ANK, CON, SMY, GRE. Turkey will build at CON and keep all fleets out of Black Sea/Aegean moves against anyone who keeps the peace. Russia: the south pact stands; please keep F SEV out of the Black Sea. Austria: Rumania and Bulgaria are neutral for now; let's agree neither of us takes RUM this Fall. Open to a balanced draw later, but Turkey needs more centers first.

Austria: Winter 1901. Agreed that France at 6 centers is a concern. Austria will build an army at BUD for defense and keep peace. Austria will not move into Rumania or Bulgaria this Fall; Turkey, we agree neither of us takes RUM this Fall. Let's discuss a 1902 plan that limits France's growth, and keep all home centers safe.

England: Winter 1901 round 2. Agreed that France at 6 centers is the board's leader; I propose we all keep builds defensive and that anyone who moves on France's home or new centers coordinates with England. England will build F LVP and hold NWY, EDI, LON, LVP. Russia: NWY stays English; Sweden is yours. Germany: DEN and HOL are yours; England will not contest them.
France: I have no hostile plans; my growth was from neutrals. I will keep my armies defensive in the west. A draw at current counts is fine by me if others agree, otherwise let's just keep peace.

Germany: Winter 1901. I agree France has grown too fast; it took BEL from me and Spain/Portugal. Germany proposes a 1902 plan: Germany and Russia/Austria/Italy coordinate to contain France. Germany will build an army at MUN for defense and will push toward BEL/RUH against France if France stays aggressive. Let's discuss concrete 1902 moves privately.

Italy: agree France at 6 centers is a balance concern. I support a coalition to check France's growth in 1902 while keeping everyone alive. Italy will hold NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN and is willing to coordinate with Austria, England, Russia or Turkey on a fair split. Let's keep reporting moves.

Russia: Winter 1901 round 2. Agree France is growing fast; a balanced 1902 is in everyone's interest. Russia will hold MOS, WAR, SEV, STP, SWE and build an army at STP now. Turkey: Russia keeps F SEV out of the Black Sea and will not enter BUL/GRE/CON. Let's discuss a coalition to check France if it keeps expanding.

Turkey: agree France is now the largest power and a balance concern. Turkey supports a 1902 plan that checks France's growth while keeping every power alive. Turkey will hold ANK, CON, SMY, GRE and build a fleet at CON. Austria, Russia: let's agree no one takes RUM or BUL in a way that leaves the other alone; I propose Turkey takes BUL, Austria takes RUM, and neither of us contests the other.
Austria: Turkey, I agree: Turkey takes BUL, Austria takes RUM. Neither of us contests the other there. Let's keep Serbia and Trieste/Vienna/Budapest safe from each other.

England: Winter 1901 round 3. Building F LVP as planned. Agree France needs checking in 1902. Proposal for a coalition: Germany and England coordinate on the north/west (England holds NWY, Germany holds HOL/DEN/BEL contest), Austria and Italy hold the south, Russia and Turkey hold the east. Any power ready to move on France, tell us now so we can time it together.

Italy: Winter 1901 round 3. Agree a 1902 plan to check France. Italy holds NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN and will not enter any home center. Italy is open to a Mediterranean understanding with Austria and Turkey: Italy keeps Tunisia and the central Med, Austria keeps the Adriatic north. Let's keep reporting moves.

Russia: Winter 1901 round 3. Agreed France is the leader and should be checked in 1902. Russia will hold MOS, WAR, SEV, STP, SWE and is building an army at STP. Germany: let's coordinate concretely in Spring; Russia is open to Rumania being contested only if Austria does not move first. Turkey: Russia keeps out of BUL, GRE and CON as agreed.

Turkey: Winter 1901 round 3. Agreed on checking France in 1902. Turkey holds ANK, CON, SMY, GRE and builds F CON. Proposal: Turkey takes BUL in Spring 1902; Austria takes RUM; Germany and England press France in the west; Italy watches the Western Med. Let's each keep home centers and share intel openly.

England: Winter 1901 round 4. Confirming F LVP build. Agree with Turkey's plan: Turkey takes BUL in Spring, Austria takes RUM, England and Germany press France in the west in 1902 once Germany confirms. Germany, please tell us your Spring 1902 orders toward BEL/BUR so we can coordinate.

Italy: Winter 1901 round 4. Italy supports the plan: Turkey takes BUL, Austria takes RUM, England and Germany press France in the west, Italy watches the Western Med and holds NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN. Italy will not enter any home center. Let's share Spring 1902 orders openly before moving.

Russia: Winter 1901 round 4. Russia supports checking France in 1902. Russia holds MOS, WAR, SEV, STP, SWE and builds A at STP. Russia will keep out of BUL and GRE; Austria and Turkey, please settle RUM between you. Russia will not attack any home center unless attacked first.

Turkey: Winter 1901 round 4. Confirmed: Turkey takes BUL in 1902, Austria takes RUM, no contest between us. Turkey builds F CON and holds ANK, SMY, GRE. Turkey supports checking France in 1902 and will share intel openly. Russia: keep F SEV out of the Black Sea and we stay friends.

Germany: Spring 1902 intent: I will move to BEL to retake it from France if France's army leaves; I will not move into PIC, BUR or France's home centers without warning. England, I am happy to coordinate in the west. France, please confirm you will keep BUR and PIC clear of your units toward Germany.

Austria: Spring 1902. I plan A BUD - RUM to take Rumania (neutral), per the Turkey agreement that Turkey takes BUL and Austria takes RUM. Russia: Austria is not entering Galicia or Ukraine and will not touch Sevastopol. Turkey: confirm you are moving A GRE/SER-BUL only, with no move on RUM. France: Austria is no threat to you; I'm happy to coordinate against your expansion with England, Germany and Italy.

England: Spring 1902 round 1. England holds EDI, LON, LVP, NWY with fleets NTH, NWY, LVP and A YOR. France has 6 centers and is the leader; I support a western containment with Germany. Germany: I am willing to coordinate on BEL/HOL in 1902; tell me your concrete orders first. Russia: please keep out of NWY and I will keep out of SWE. Let's share Spring orders openly.

France: let's not fight. I'll keep BUR and PIC clear of aggression toward you if you leave BEL alone. England is the real rival in the Channel and North Sea; I'd rather coordinate with you against English moves.

Germany: Spring 1902. I plan to retake BEL: A HOL to BEL supported by F KIE/DEN and A MUN. France, France holds BEL with an army; if you keep BEL and BUR clear of aggression toward Germany I will hold, but I will not allow further French growth into Germany's area. England: I suggest F NTH supports HOL-BEL to pressure France together. Russia and Austria: Germany stays out of your homes and will keep the northern balance. Please report any moves.

Italy: Spring 1902. France holds 6 centers with units at PAR, MAR, BRE, BEL, POR, SPA. Italy holds NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN and will not enter any home center. Italy's Spring orders: hold home centers, and F TUN watches the Western Med. Germany and England: please confirm your west plans against France so we can time it.

Russia: Spring 1902 round 1. Russia holds MOS, WAR, SEV, STP, SWE. France is at 6 centers and must be checked. Russia is ready to coordinate a Spring plan: Germany, Austria, Italy, England, please share your Spring orders now. Russia's plan is to hold home centers and take Rumania or Ukraine only if Turkey and Austria stay settled.

Turkey: Spring 1902. Turkey moves F CON to BUL/SC to take neutral Bulgaria, with A GRE supporting. Austria: RUM is yours as agreed; Turkey will not enter Rumania. Russia: keep F SEV out of the Black Sea. France: Turkey has no quarrel with you; let's coordinate on checking your growth. Please share Spring orders openly.

England: Spring 1902 round 2. Agreed: Germany retakes BEL. England will support HOL/BEL with F NTH and A YOR toward the Low Countries, so France's BEL army can be pressured. Germany, confirm your orders are A HOL-BEL with support from KIE/DEN/MUN. England stays out of DEN and HOL except supports. Russia: NWY stays English, SWE stays yours.
France: I am not attacking either of you. I'll hold BEL, BUR clear. Note England's fleets could take HOL/DEN from Germany while you fight me. Let's keep the west quiet and all profit from the east.

Italy: Spring 1902 round 2. Italy holds NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN with no moves against any home center. Italy will hold this Spring and watch the Western Med. Germany and England: when you move on France in the west, please state orders first so we can coordinate. Austria: noted RUM plan; Italy has no move there.

Russia to Austria: Rumania is contested. SEV is held by Russia; if you move A BUD to RUM, Russia may move F SEV to RUM and bounce you. Suggest you keep out of RUM and Ukraine, and Russia will keep out of Serbia and Budapest. Let's talk about a better split.

Turkey: Spring 1902 round 2. Confirmed: Turkey moves F CON to BUL/SC with A GRE support, and no Turkish unit enters RUM. Austria: RUM is yours as agreed, and I expect A SER to stay out of BUL. Russia: F SEV stays out of the Black Sea. Germany and England: Turkey supports checking France in the west and will share orders openly.

Austria to Russia: I plan A BUD-RUM and I will not move toward Galicia or Ukraine. If you bounce me with F SEV to RUM, we both lose a unit for nothing. Propose: Russia takes Ukraine and Galicia is left to Austria only if you concede Rumania. Please tell me your Spring orders now.

England: Spring 1902 round 3. Germany, confirm your HOL-BEL orders. England will support with F NTH S A HOL-BEL or similar, and keep HOL/DEN for Germany. France: you hold BEL now; if your army leaves BEL, Germany retakes it. Russia and Austria: England holds NWY and SWE is yours. Let's publish final orders before moves.

Italy: Spring 1902 round 3. Italy holds NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN and will not enter any home center. Italy's only Spring moves are holds and F TUN in the Western Med. Germany and England: good luck on BEL; Italy supports checking France and will share intel. Please keep your orders public.

Russia to Austria: if you move A BUD to RUM, Russia will likely contest with F SEV and bounce you, which helps no one. I suggest Austria holds this Spring and Russia holds SEV. Let's keep Ukraine, Galicia and Serbia clear of each other and discuss a fair split for Rumania in Fall.

England: Spring 1902 round 4. Final: my orders are F NTH supports Germany's HOL-BEL attack if Germany commits, F NWY holds, F LVP holds, A YOR holds. England does not move into DEN or HOL. Germany, confirm your orders now; France, if you hold BEL with your army, expect pressure.

Italy: Spring 1902 round 4. Italy holds NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN with no moves against any home center. Italy's orders are holds plus F TUN watching the Western Med. Germany, England: good luck on BEL. Italy will share intel openly.

Russia to Austria: Russia's Spring orders are holds on SEV, WAR, MOS and STP, with F SWE moving to hold. Russia will bounce any move into RUM with F SEV, so please hold this Spring. We can split Rumania in Fall if you agree; Russia does not want to lose units to a bounce.

Austria: Fall 1902. Germany's HOL-BEL bounced and France still holds BEL. Austria proposes Turkey takes BUL (done) and Austria takes RUM this Fall with A BUD-RUM supported by A SER. Russia: Austria will not enter Galicia, Ukraine or Sevastopol. If you keep F SEV out of RUM, we both keep units. Turkey: confirm you will not move into RUM. Let's keep reporting Fall orders publicly.

England: Fall 1902 round 1. France has taken BEL and moved a fleet into ENG, a direct threat to our Channel and London. I will hold LON/LVP/EDI and back Germany against France in the west. France, please explain F ENG and your plans. Germany: let's coordinate retaking BEL this Fall; England can support HOL/BEL from NTH.

Italy: Fall 1902 round 1. France is now at 6 centers with a fleet in the Channel and armies at BEL, BUR, MAR. Italy holds NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN and will keep home centers. Germany and England: Italy is ready to share orders and coordinate a containment of France this Fall. Turkey and Austria: any unclaimed RUM/BUL moves should be announced first.

Russia: Fall 1902 round 1. Russia holds MOS, WAR, SEV, STP, SWE and will not attack any home center. France now has 6 centers and a fleet in the Channel (ENG). Germany and England: Russia is open to coordinating against France's Channel and Belgium if France keeps growing. Austria and Turkey: Rumania is still open; Russia will contest only if Austria moves into RUM. Please share Fall orders.

Turkey: Fall 1902 round 1. F CON reached BUL/SC; Bulgaria should flip to Turkey this Fall. Turkey holds ANK, CON, SMY, GRE and will keep all units out of home centers. Austria: RUM remains yours; Turkey will not enter it. Russia: keep F SEV out of the Black Sea. France: Turkey has no quarrel with you; please keep your fleets away from the Aegean and Med. Let's share Fall orders openly.

Austria: Fall 1902 round 2. Austria will move A BUD-RUM with A SER support this Fall to take neutral Rumania. Russia: Austria will not enter Galicia, Ukraine or Sevastopol; please keep F SEV out of RUM so no units are lost. Turkey: Austria expects no Turkish move into RUM. France: Austria has no quarrel with you; keep your fleets out of the Adriatic and Balkans.

England: Fall 1902 round 2. France's F ENG threatens our Channel. I propose a joint strike: Germany A HOL-BEL with England F NTH supporting, and England's F LVP and A YOR attacking ENG to dislodge the French fleet. Germany, confirm; France, please withdraw F ENG to avoid losses. Russia and Italy: any support against France in the west is welcome.

France: F ENG is purely defensive; I will not attack LON or any English/German home center this Fall. I only hold BEL, BUR. Neither of you needs to attack me; the real growth is in the east (Turkey, Austria, Russia). Let's hold the west.

Germany: Fall 1902. France now holds BEL with an army and has F ENG in the Channel. I intend to retake BEL this Fall with A RUH-BEL supported by A HOL and England's F NTH if available. England: please support HOL-BEL or RUH-BEL from NTH. I will not enter any home center other than the attack on BEL, which is a neutral-held center for France. Let's share orders publicly.

Italy: Fall 1902 round 2. Italy holds NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN and will not enter any home center. France: please explain F ENG and A BUR moves. Italy is watching the Western Med and is open to a joint containment of France with Germany and England in 1903. Austria, Turkey: Italy has no moves against RUM or BUL.

Russia: Fall 1902 round 2. Russia holds MOS, WAR, SEV, STP, SWE and will hold this Fall. Austria: Russia will keep F SEV in place; if you move into RUM, expect a bounce, so let's discuss a Fall split of Rumania next year. Turkey: Russia keeps out of BUL, GRE and CON. Germany and England: Russia supports containing France in the west.

Turkey: Fall 1902 round 2. Turkey confirms it will not move into RUM this Fall; RUM is Austria's per our pact. Turkey's F BUL/SC stays in Bulgaria to hold it. Russia: please keep F SEV out of the Black Sea. Turkey supports containing France and will share orders openly.

England: Fall 1902 round 3. Germany, I will support your HOL-BEL or RUH-BEL attack from NTH this Fall; please confirm your exact orders now. France: F ENG must leave the Channel or it will be dislodged. England holds LON, LVP, EDI, NWY and will not enter any home center of another power.

Italy: Fall 1902 round 3. Italy holds NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN and makes no moves against any home center. Italy supports the Germany/England move to retake BEL and check France. Italy's Fall orders: holds, F TUN watching the Western Med. Please keep sharing orders publicly.

Russia to Austria: F SEV will hold in place this Fall and will bounce any move into RUM. If you move A BUD-RUM, you risk losing a unit. Russia is open to a Fall 1903 split of Rumania if you hold now. Please confirm you will keep out of Galicia, Ukraine and Sevastopol.

England: Fall 1902 round 4. Germany, I am ready to support HOL-BEL from NTH this Fall; please confirm your orders. France, F ENG should withdraw; England will not attack unless provoked. All other powers: England will hold home centers and publish final orders before moves.

Germany: Fall 1902 final. My orders: A RUH-BEL with A HOL support, F KIE/DEN and A BER hold home. England: NTH support on BEL would be welcome. France: please vacate BEL, and keep your fleets out of the North Sea and German homes.

Italy: Fall 1902 round 4. Italy holds NAP, ROM, VEN, TUN and keeps all units at home this Fall. Germany and England: Italy supports the BEL retake plan. France: withdraw from the Channel and Belgium area or expect a united response.

England: Winter 1902. The BEL attack failed and France holds BEL, ENG remains French. Austria and Turkey have grown to 5 each, France is at 6, England and Italy at 4. Proposal: France must give up BEL or ENG by Spring; Germany and England retake BEL together in 1903.
